text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Touched by the passionate feelings of 
Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki, Sakura 
Chiyono O reawakens to the fact that she 
carries Maruzensky's dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...She began pushing herself further and 
further, and as a result of secretly 
training on her own, something went wrong 
with her legs."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Noticing she was trying to hide her 
symptoms, the Trainer took her back to her 
family home to give her time to focus on 
rehabilitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know she's grown desperate not to lose 
to her rivals. But that doesn't mean I can 
let her push herself too far and risk 
cutting her racing career short.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Supported by hospital treatment and her 
family's love, she continued her efforts 
to move forward, even wearing down the 
tatami mats back home.
